    <script>

        const fg = el.classList.contains("hl") || el.classList.contains("neg") ? "#ffffff" : "#f6fdff";
        tl.fromTo(sel, { backgroundColor: "rgba(15,181,201,0)", color: "#0a1a33", scale: 1 },
          { backgroundColor: hl, color: fg, scale: 1.08, duration: 0.08, ease: "none" }, s);
